subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Should Scrapling be restored as a false positive, kept hidden under current content policy/security findings, or treated as a publish/update regression that needs a code fix?
rationale: Only production moderation/audit data and maintainer policy intent can safely decide whether to unhide a security-moderated public listing.

options.title: Private moderation review first
options.body: Inspect the production moderation record and restore or override the skill if the current hidden state is an unintended scanner or workflow false positive.

options.title: Keep hidden under policy
options.body: If the current policy or artifact evidence requires hiding Scrapling, explain that outcome to the reporter and keep the policy discussion on the RFC.

options.title: Open a focused code fix
options.body: If audit data shows updates are incorrectly hiding a previously clean version, implement a narrow regression fix with coverage for the update path.

recommendation.title: Private moderation review first
recommendation.body: Inspect the production moderation record and restore or override the skill if the current hidden state is an unintended scanner or workflow false positive.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the relevant backend/security paths by CODEOWNERS history and has the strongest recent history on publish staging, scan dispatch, and the prior Scrapling moderation response.
